decisions.note: A-1(a) RULING (Fold C/D, orchestrator, 2026-08-29, within the pre-authorized plan): the JS arithmetic-mean fallback is RETIRED WHOLE (guards.requires: postgis, on_missing: fail — the link_massing A-8 precedent), not kept-declared-unreachable. The PostGIS branch is ONE UPDATE ... RETURNING id with no loop, so it has no cursor-pagination analogue to preserve, and none is needed — a server-side UPDATE cannot infinite-loop on a malformed row the way the retired client-side re-scan could.

A-4 RULING (Fold C, AMENDED Fold D, 2026-08-29): class E write_once_backfill was genuinely unimplemented in write.js (SET_BASED_CLASSES excluded it, sqlLiteral refuses server-side expressions) — ships LG-20 (executeBackfillUpdate, guard:"none" per Rule 9, idempotent BY SCOPE) + a thin runBackfillPhase (ACCEPT, a fork of isCascadeStep/isMaterializeStep's shape, not an extension of runLinkPhase/runMaterializePhase). LG-21's shared phase-runner scaffold is explicitly DEFERRED to a post-pilot-8 library WF, not shipped in this pilot.

R-1/CC-D2 RULING (Reality-Check, Fold C, PIN + HIGH followup): of 3,626 out-of-polygon centroids, 3,130 land inside a different parcel, exposing a 276-link mis-attribution signature in link-parcels.js's Tier-3 nearest-centroid join. This step's own output is correct per its own contract (Spec 59 R2.5); the exposure is a downstream consumer's join-strategy defect, PINNED for this pilot's zero-behaviour-change scope.

R-F item 1 (carried forward, same disposition as pilot 5): this step has no destructive retraction target (class E, retract:"none"), so it does NOT exercise or close R-B's crashed/stuck-running reader gap — carried to whichever future pilot first ships a genuine retract_when:"full_only" target. R-P is N/A: no terminals[].kind==="skip_gated" entry exists, because this BACKFILL's zero-work completion is DATA-driven (backlog_count == 0), never a ledger gate.

CC-D3 FULL-mode RULING (WF3, 2026-08-30, Spec 124 §7 rung (a)+(d)): the operator authorized a one-off before-imaged centroid recompute rather than a throwaway script. A SECOND write target (`outputs.writes[1]`, class set_based_scoped/set_source:"compute", LG-22) declares the repair — genuinely unimplemented in write.js before this WF3 (SET_BASED_CLASSES's constant-only sqlLiteral codegen cannot express a server-side SET expression; widening sqlLiteral itself was rejected as an injection surface for every OTHER set-based target, so `set_source: "compute"` opts THIS target out of codegen the same way write_once_backfill/set_based_join_update/insert_only_no_retraction already do). Reachable ONLY via override.force_full (COMPUTE_CENTROIDS_FORCE_FULL) — R-L precedent: never a corpus-signal autonomous trigger, because unlike the incremental fill this write is idempotent-by-GUARD, not idempotent-by-SCOPE, a materially riskier shape to leave scheduled. R-M's before-image mechanism (previously step-scoped "none" — no destructive retraction existed) is GENERALIZED to a value-overwriting guarded write: an overwrite of a real prior value is not reversible by re-nulling the way the incremental fill's NULL->value write is.

CC-D3 LIVE REPAIR, RED-FIRST BUG (WF3, 2026-08-30): the FIRST drift_select_sql compared the stored NUMERIC(10,7) centroid against a bare, unrounded ST_Centroid double via IS DISTINCT FROM — src/tests/db/compute-centroids-full-recompute.db.test.ts case ① went red (a row stamped with its OWN correct centroid was NOT excluded by the guard), proving the guard would have rewritten the ENTIRE table on every run, defeating idempotent_rerun:"zero_writes". Fixed by rounding BOTH sides to the column's own precision (ROUND(...::numeric,7)) before comparing. Live run then repaired 395,085/486,530 (81.2%) parcels in 149.1s (any-magnitude guard, a strict superset of the 292,587 >1m population that discovered CC-D3); centroid_algorithm_drift_gt_1m_count 292,587 -> 0; a second forced-FULL run selected 0 rows (idempotency proven, not asserted); 60-parcel plausibility sample (setseed(0.20260830001)) measured 59/60 (98.3%) new centroids inside their own polygon. outside_polygon_count 3,626 -> 1,547 and centroid_in_neighbour_parcel_count 3,130 -> 1,344 DROPPED (Spec 59 R2.5 concave-lot residual, not eliminated — CC-D2 stays PIN).
